  1540	    def _preempt_request(
  1541	        self, request: Request, timestamp: float, drop_stale_output: bool = False
  1542	    ) -> None:
  1543	        """Preempt a request and put it back to the waiting queue.
  1544	
  1545	        NOTE: The request should be popped from the running queue outside of this
  1546	        method.
  1547	
  1548	        drop_stale_output: drop (rather than deliver) any in-flight output; used
  1549	        by reset_prefix_cache, whose same-step resume would otherwise deliver
  1550	        tokens out of order, and for connectors with a pending KV hand-off,
  1551	        which the preemption's block free would leave without valid KV.
  1552	        """
  1553	        assert request.status == RequestStatus.RUNNING, (
  1554	            "Only running requests can be preempted"
  1555	        )
  1556	        if self.aux_output_connector is not None:
  1557	            self.aux_output_connector.request_finished(request)
  1558	        self._free_request_blocks(request)
  1559	        self.encoder_cache_manager.free(request)
  1560	        self._inflight_prefills.discard(request)
  1561	        request.status = RequestStatus.PREEMPTED
  1562	        request.num_computed_tokens = 0
  1563	        if request.spec_token_ids:
  1564	            request.spec_token_ids = []
  1565	        # Async scheduling: mark all in-flight output as stale. Its tokens are
  1566	        # still delivered on return (dropping them would perturb spec-decode
  1567	        # acceptance) but must not mutate the reset counters; each step drains
  1568	        # its share in update_from_output. num_in_flight_tokens already
  1569	        # includes any undrained stale share, so assign rather than accumulate.
  1570	        # An undrained drop-mode share stays dropped: its positions have
  1571	        # already been resampled.
  1572	        request.drop_stale_output = drop_stale_output or (
  1573	            request.drop_stale_output and request.num_stale_output_tokens > 0
  1574	        )
  1575	        request.num_stale_output_tokens = request.num_in_flight_tokens
  1575	        request.num_stale_output_tokens = request.num_in_flight_tokens
  1576	        request.num_output_placeholders = 0
  1577	        request.num_preemptions += 1

  1579	            request.record_event(EngineCoreEventType.PREEMPTED, timestamp)
  1580	
  1581	        # Put the request back to the waiting queue.
  1582	        self.waiting.prepend_request(request)

  1587	        # the request is scheduled.

  1589	        #    original number of scheduled tokens to determine input IDs.

  1661	    def _make_cached_request_data(
